# Doni Wirawan

> Doni Wirawan builds small, free, privacy-first web tools. The public ones run
> entirely in the browser and upload nothing you put into them. He also builds and
> maintains the sites and internal software for the Studio Five group and a set of
> marine-fuel companies.

Site: https://doniwirawan.xyz

## Free tools

- [Ascent](https://ascent-analytics.doniwirawan.xyz): a Strava analytics dashboard. [Source](https://github.com/doniwirawan/Ascent-Strava-Dashboard)
- [Bike Fit Analyzer](https://bikefit.doniwirawan.xyz): browser-based bike fit analysis. [Source](https://github.com/doniwirawan/bike-fit-analyzer)
- [Aksara Bali](https://aksarabali.doniwirawan.xyz): a Latin-to-Balinese script transliterator, and an educational tool for reading, writing and preserving Aksara Bali. There is also an offline [Android app on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=xyz.doniwirawan.aksara_bali_mobile). [Source](https://github.com/doniwirawan/aksara-bali)
- [SPMB Bali 2026](https://spmbbali.doniwirawan.xyz): Bali school-admission data, made searchable. [Source](https://github.com/doniwirawan/spmb-bali-2026)

## Aksara Bali guides

Written by the author of the converter. Each one is server-rendered, so its full
text is in the HTML, and each ends in an FAQ marked up as FAQPage.

- [How a Balinese Script Translator Actually Works](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/how-a-balinese-script-translator-works): what a Balinese script generator does between the Latin you type and the aksara you get — syllable splitting, the inherent vowel, gantungan and gempelan, and the three places every converter has to guess. In English.
- [Cara Translate Latin ke Aksara Bali Online](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/cara-translate-latin-ke-aksara-bali): the practical steps, plus the four mistakes that turn up most often (the two `e` sounds, `ng`/`ny`, stacked consonants, Sanskrit loanwords). In Indonesian.
- [Aksara Bali Anda Jadi Kotak? Ini Sebabnya](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/aksara-bali-jadi-kotak-di-hp): why Balinese script renders as empty boxes, the Unicode block it lives in (U+1B00–U+1B7F), and how Unicode text differs from legacy Bali Simbar text. In Indonesian.
- [Menulis Nama Anda dalam Aksara Bali](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/menulis-nama-dalam-aksara-bali): converting a personal name specifically — why names are the hardest case for any transliterator, the letters Balinese script does not have (v, f, q, x, z), and why the result should be checked by a person before it is tattooed or printed. In Indonesian.
- [Belajar Aksara Bali dari Nol](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/belajar-aksara-bali-dari-nol): a learning order that starts with the six vowel marks rather than the consonant table, then the syllable-final marks, then consonants, then gantungan/gempelan. In Indonesian.

Note on terminology used throughout: these tools transliterate, they do not
translate. The language stays the same; only the writing system changes.

## Bike fitting guides

Written by the author of Bike Fit Analyzer, in Indonesian. The angle ranges they
quote are the ones the tool grades against; the sources are listed in each post
and in [bikefit-research-ranges.md](https://github.com/doniwirawan/bike-fit-analyzer/blob/main/files/bikefit-research-ranges.md).

- [Bike Fitting Itu Apa, dan Cara Mengeceknya Sendiri dari Video](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/bike-fitting-cek-sendiri-dari-video): what bike fitting is, the four side-on angles a fitter looks at (knee at BDC 30-40 deg, torso from horizontal 40-50, elbow 15-30, shoulder 80-95), how to film a clip worth measuring, and the limits of a 2D check.
- [Tinggi Sadel Sepeda yang Benar](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/tinggi-sadel-sepeda-yang-benar): saddle height by knee angle rather than by formula, why published numbers differ (dynamic 30-40 vs static Holmes 25-35), and the signs of too high and too low.
- [Nyeri Lutut Saat Bersepeda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/nyeri-lutut-saat-bersepeda): which fit error each pain location commonly points to, and when to stop adjusting and see a physiotherapist.
- [Sakit Punggung dan Leher Saat Bersepeda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/sakit-punggung-dan-leher-saat-bersepeda): reach and bar height, the cheap adjustments to try in order, and why numb hands is treated differently from ache.
- [Ukuran Sepeda Sesuai Tinggi Badan](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/ukuran-sepeda-sesuai-tinggi-badan): frame sizing before fitting — why height alone is the wrong input, what inseam and stack/reach tell you instead, and which sizing mistakes can still be fixed after purchase.
- [Pantat Sakit Saat Bersepeda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/pantat-sakit-saat-bersepeda): saddle soreness — what is normal adaptation and what is not, measuring sit-bone width, why a softer saddle makes it worse, and why numbness is treated separately.
- [Posisi Cleat Sepeda yang Benar](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/posisi-cleat-sepeda-yang-benar): the three cleat axes (fore-aft, rotation, lateral), and the honest note that this is the one part of a fit a side-on camera cannot check at all.
- [Bike Fit untuk Road, Gravel, dan MTB](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/bike-fit-road-gravel-mtb): which parts of a fit carry across bikes (saddle height, cleats) and which do not (everything in front of you), and why the torso target differs by bike type. TT/tri positions fall outside these ranges entirely.

Two corrections these posts make to advice that circulates widely: measured-while-
pedalling angles run about 8 degrees higher than static goniometer numbers, so the
two sets of published targets are not in conflict; and a small amount of pelvic
rock is normal in correctly-fitted riders (7.1 +/- 2.5 deg), so it is not on its
own evidence of a saddle that is too high.

None of it is medical advice.

## Strava and training-data guides

Written by the author of Ascent, in Indonesian.

- [Zona Latihan Bersepeda: Heart Rate, Power, dan FTP](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/zona-latihan-bersepeda-heart-rate-ftp): what FTP is and how it is tested (20-minute test x 0.95), the seven power zones as percentages of FTP, how heart-rate zones differ from power zones and why, and the common mistake of spending every session in zone 3.
- [Cara Membaca Data Strava Anda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/cara-membaca-data-strava): which numbers on an activity actually inform a decision (moving time, zone distribution, cadence, heart-rate trend on a repeated route) and which mislead (average speed, max speed, calories).
- [Eddington Number Bersepeda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/eddington-number-bersepeda): the largest E for which you have ridden at least E km on E separate days — a consistency measure that a few big rides cannot inflate, how to compute it, and why it gets harder to raise.
- [Cara Membuat Story Strava](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/cara-membuat-story-strava): exporting a 1080x1920 activity card with chosen layout, colours and stats, including transparent backgrounds to place over your own photo.

- [Aman Nggak Menyambungkan Strava ke Aplikasi Pihak Ketiga?](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/aman-connect-strava-ke-aplikasi-pihak-ketiga): what the OAuth scopes mean, five questions for judging any third-party Strava app, how to revoke access at strava.com/settings/apps, and Ascent answered against that same checklist.
- [Konsistensi Bersepeda](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/konsistensi-bersepeda-heatmap-streak): reading a calendar heatmap and a map heatmap, what active-days-per-week tells you that monthly distance hides, and why streaks punish rest days.
- [Segment, PR, KOM, dan Local Legend di Strava](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/segment-pr-kom-strava): what each term means (Local Legend rewards frequency, not speed), why segment leaderboards control for nothing, and why your own PR is the useful number.
- [Kadens Bersepeda yang Ideal](https://doniwirawan.xyz/blog/kadens-bersepeda-yang-ideal): the trade-off cadence actually makes between joint load and cardiovascular load, and why the widely-quoted 90 rpm is an observation of professionals rather than a settled optimum.

Precise note on where Ascent's data goes, since the posts are careful about it:
activity data is fetched by the visitor's own browser directly from the Strava
API and never passes through the author's server. The one exception is the OAuth
code-for-token exchange, which goes through a stateless function because the
Strava client secret cannot ship to a browser; it stores nothing. Tokens and the
activity cache live in the visitor's own localStorage.
